snippet.title: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla - Official Reveal Trailer | Indian Horror Game 2026 #bhangarhgame
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4201310

Step into India's most haunted location. Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla is a first-person supernatural horror experience inspired by the chilling legends of Bhangarh Fort. As Vikram Avasthi, you must enter the cursed ruins to find your missing brother , but you are not alone. Uncover the dark story of Princess and the infamous sorcerer Singhia, and try to escape the curse that has claimed countless souls.

Key Features: 
💀 Explore the Real Bhangarh: Detailed 3D environments of the famous fort ruins. 
🕯️ Folklore-Driven Horror: Experience a story rooted in real Indian myths and local lore.
 🧩 Ritual Puzzles: Solve culturally inspired puzzles to survive the night.
 🎞️ Multiple Endings: Your choices determine if you escape or join the spirits.

#Rudravati #Ratnavati #BhangarhFort #HorrorGames #IndianGaming #IndieGame #Supernatural #UpcomingIndianGames2026

DISCLAIMER:
This game is a work of fiction. While inspired by the real legends & folklore, this is a creative interpretation for entertainment purposes only. All characters, names, events, and supernatural depictions are fictitious.
The developers do not claim historical or factual accuracy and are not affiliated with any government body. This game does not promote or encourage trespassing at protected sites, nor does it intend to offend or disparage any religion, community, or local belief system.
Player discretion is advised. All depictions of the 'curse' are purely for the purpose of gameplay and narrative.
